text: FIX on the Dexie.js RxStorage, `collection.remove()` and `resetCollectionOnSchemaChange` only cleared the documents and kept the IndexedDB database with its old object stores. When the collection was added again with a schema of the same version that has another primary key, queries threw a `NotFoundError`. The attachment data of the removed collection also stayed on disk. `remove()` of the Dexie.js storage instance now deletes the whole IndexedDB database
